description.es: Plataforma web para la gestión de catálogos, inventarios y administración, desarrollada con React, TypeScript, Node.js y PostgreSQL.
description.en: Full-stack web platform for catalog, inventory, and administrative management, built with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

description.es: Sistema SaaS B2B multi-tenant para la gestión integral de clubes e instituciones deportivas. Arquitectura desacoplada con Frontend React, Backend Node.js/Express y App Móvil Flutter con soporte offline-first.
description.en: Multi-tenant B2B SaaS for the comprehensive management of sports clubs and organizations. Decoupled architecture with a React frontend, Node.js/Express backend, and Flutter mobile app with offline-first support.

description.es: Plataforma de comercio electrónico Full Stack con patrón de arquitectura MVC. Catálogo interactivo de productos, carrito de compras, gestión de pedidos y almacenamiento relacional en MySQL.
description.en: Full Stack E-commerce platform following MVC architecture pattern. Interactive product catalog, shopping cart, order management, and relational MySQL database.
